Package dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla

Class BannerItemType

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemType
dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla.BannerItemType
public final class BannerItemType extends BedrockItemType
The constant BedrockItems.BANNER: minecraft:banner, with a getter per variant BDS names in Bedrock 26.60, the newest bundled release. The names are BDS's own (the localization key of the stack). As a type it is its base variant, aux 0, like any type.

A variant Bedrock removes keeps its getter, deprecated; a name BDS changes stays as a deprecated alias of the new one. @SincePreview marks variants only the bundled Bedrock preview has.

Since:
1.0.0
